meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Webex 聊天通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 Webex 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat channel into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能为项目接入 Cisco Webex 频道:从 channels 分支复制 Webex 适配器并注册,安装固定版本依赖,构建并跑集成测试;还会引导填写机器人令牌和 webhook 密钥,写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Webex 频道,或正在 /setup 流程中时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 Webex 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 添加 Webex 集成并配置机器人令牌
say.note: 会提示粘贴令牌和 webhook 密钥。

say.text: 给项目加上 Webex 并跑通测试
say.note: 会构建并运行集成测试。

howto.what_en: Installing this lets Claude integrate a Webex channel: it copies and registers the Webex adapter, installs the pinned dependency, builds, and runs the integration test, then guides filling bot token/webhook secret into .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Webex channel, or while running the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add a Webex channel for me
say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers it, and installs dependencies.

say_en.text: Add Webex integration and configure the bot token
say_en.note: Prompts for token and webhook secret.

say_en.text: Add Webex to the project and make the tests pass
say_en.note: Builds and runs the integration test.
